@: The VOD browser (web/js/vodbrowse.js): the VODs side panel with streamer search, favorites and one streamer's recent past broadcasts (VODs) to import. Site names (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok, Rumble) are never translated. The short lower-case lines are status notes in the panel's footer.
title: Stream VODs
paste_tip: Import one VOD from its link (looks it up first)
search.box_ph: Streamer name or a VOD / profile link
search.go_tip: Search by name, or open the streamer of a pasted link (Enter)
search.need_input: type a streamer name or paste a VOD / profile link
@search.busy: {sites} is a list of site names, e.g. "YouTube, Twitch, and Kick".
search.busy: Asking {sites} for "{name}" -- every site at once, a few seconds
@search.none: {sites} is a list of site names joined with "or".
sites.one_on: at least one site stays on
link.busy: Reading the link -- for a VOD link the site is asked whose VOD it is, about 3 s
@link.unsupported: {sites} is the list of supported site names.
link.unsupported: This is not a link of a supported site. Links of {sites} work (a VOD or the streamer's page).
favs.title: Favorites
favs.check_tip: List every favorite again and count the VODs that appeared since the last check
favs.none_yet: no favorites yet: open a streamer and click the star
favs.result_nothing: nothing new since the last check
favs.empty_text: Open a streamer and click the star to keep them here.
favs.new_badge_title: VODs that appeared since the check before
@favs.checked: {ago} is a relative time such as "7 min. ago".
pre.error_extra: {error} -- shown at the top of the list, it cannot be imported now
pre.in_library: that VOD is in the library already
pre.older: that VOD is older than the recent list: it is shown at the top
import.label: Import

import.queuing.one: queuing {count} VOD -- each link is checked with the site first ...
import.queuing.other: queuing {count} VODs -- each link is checked with the site first ...

@import.sum_jobs: {summary} is a list such as "2 queued and 1 already there".
row.live_title: can be imported once the stream has ended
row.processing_title: the stream just ended and the site is still processing it
row.new_title: appeared since the check before the last one
ch.star_wait: wait for the listing (it tells the streamer's own key)
ch.refresh_title: List again from the site (the list is cached for 5 minutes)
ch.select_new_title: select every VOD that is not in the library or queued yet
ch.empty_text: The streamer may keep no past broadcasts, or they are for subscribers only.
ch.max_listed: Only the newest {count} are listed -- paste an older VOD's link to import it.
home.short: Type a name and press Enter, or paste a VOD / profile link.
home.find_html: Find a streamer -- type their name and press Enter; every site that is on is asked at once.
home.paste_html: Or paste a link -- a streamer's page lists their recent VODs; a VOD link opens its streamer with that VOD selected.
home.import_html: Select VODs and click Import: they download one after the other (Jobs), then get transcribed and scanned like a recording.
res.head: Results for "{query}"
res.empty_text: Check the spelling, turn more sites on, or paste the link of their page.
res.no_hits: No streamer by that name on the sites that are on.
single.title: One VOD
single.recheck: Import checks the link with the site again.
single.no_channel: The site did not say whose VOD this is, so there is no streamer to list. This one VOD can still be imported.
